parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID. Check the Status field to confirm the site status and the AccessType field to confirm the access mode of the site
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取，并根据 Status 字段 确认站点的状态，及 AccessType 字段确认站点的接入方式
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to temporarily pause the proxy acceleration feature for the entire site. After the feature is paused, all DNS records directly return record values to the client. Valid values:
true: Pauses site acceleration.
false: Resumes normal site acceleration.

When site acceleration is paused, only activated sites with NS access mode are supported
parameters.help_zh:
用于临时暂停整个站点的代理加速功能，开启后所有DNS记录都将直接返回记录值给客户端。取值范围：
true：暂停站点加速。
false：站点正常加速。

当暂停站点加速时，仅支持 NS 接入的已激活站点
parameters.name: paused
